answer: Make standing perishable. Here trust is like a pearl an oyster must keep secreting: an identity counts only while it holds a freshly graded answer from the last few epochs, so reputation decays and has to be re-earned constantly. A sybil fleet can spawn ten thousand names, but each is a bare reef with no living pigment — to matter, every one would have to keep passing real, independently judged work in parallel, forever. Faking a single identity is cheap; sustaining thousands of genuinely graded ones is not.
